Excited to share VideoTube a full-stack video streaming platform that became one of my biggest learning experiences as a developer.

When I started this project, my goal was simple: learn backend development by building something real. What followed was weeks of designing APIs, debugging countless errors, integrating services, and understanding how a production-level application comes together.

Through VideoTube, I learned:
 Authentication & Authorization with JWT
 REST API design and backend architecture
 MongoDB data modeling
 File uploads and media management with Cloudinary
 Frontend Backend integration
 Deployment and production setup

Features:
 Video Upload & Streaming
 Comments, Likes & Subscriptions
 Playlists
 User Dashboard
 Secure Authentication
 Responsive UI

Tech Stack: React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Cloudinary, Tailwind CSS

There were many moments when a small change broke something else, and some bugs took hours to solve. But every error taught me something new and helped me become a better developer.

Github repo: https://lnkd.in/gEvcR6VP
Live Demo: https://lnkd.in/gtjjdhAr

#FullStackDevelopment #MERN #BackendDevelopment #ReactJS #NodeJS #MongoDB #WebDevelopment #SoftwareEngineering

Had a great experience participating in AM HACKS 2.0 hosted by Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women with my team CodeCrunchers.

This hackathon strengthened my problem-solving mindset, teamwork under tight deadlines, and ability to design user-centric solutions with real-world impact. It reinforced an important lesson for me: meaningful tech starts with understanding people s needs.

We presented an upgraded version of our Smart India Hackathon project PrepConnect, a disaster management platform focused on making emergency response faster, smarter, and more inclusive. Key additions included an AI assistant, personalized My Needs profiles, and a localized SOS system for real-time community support.

Proud of what we built and grateful for the learning journey.

Thrilled to announce that our team, Stack OverFlowers, has successfully cleared Round 1 of the Internal Smart India Hackathon 2025! 
The journey so far has been an incredible learning experience filled with innovation, teamwork, and the drive to create something meaningful.
Our problem statement challenged us to design a
 Disaster preparedness and response education system for schools and colleges. 
To address this, we built PrepConnect, a web platform aimed at transforming disaster management education into an interactive and engaging experience for students.
 Highlights of PrepConnect:
 Gamified Learning: Multi-level quiz modules that make learning fun while tracking progress.
 Virtual Mock Drills: Simulated emergency scenarios offering a safe and realistic learning experience.
 Emergency Directory: Verified contact details from every Indian state for easy access in critical situations.
What began as a hackathon challenge quickly evolved into a mission to explore how technology can empower students to be better prepared and resilient during crises.
I m immensely proud of what we ve accomplished together as a team: Vaibhav Singla, Aryan Kumar Shrivastav and Bhavya Bansal .
 Take a look at our project here: https://lnkd.in/dvgSBB2V

While we didn't make it to the final round, I came away with something more valuable experience. This hackathon taught me that building great products isn't just about technical skills; it's also about communication, adaptability, and teamwork.
Grateful to my teammates Vaibhav Singla, Bhavya Bansal, Aryan Kumar Srivastava, mentors, judges, and the organizers of Vihaan 9.0 for an amazing experience.
